item.title: Model Context Protocol for Non-Developers: A Practical Primer
item.description: MCP is the reason Claude can read your actual spreadsheet instead of asking you to paste it in. The Model Context Protocol is an open standard — released by Anthropic in November 2024, now governed under the Linux Foundation — that lets Claude connect to external tools, files, and services in a standardised way. This primer explains what that means for researchers and science communicators who want more from Claude without learning to code.
